indicators.label: Census resident population
indicators.description: Samoa's 2021 census resident population, summed exactly from the committed constituency rows to four statistical regions.
indicators.method: Sum the committed constituency population_total values by the aua, nwu, rou, and sav area_code prefixes.
indicators.quality_notes: Religion is published and staged for 51 electoral constituencies, but no licensed constituency boundary layer exists. The map renders the census's four statistical regions, the workbook's own roll-up, until the Samoa Bureau of Statistics supplies a constituency vector; the full constituency table ships in the committed data product.

indicators.label: Religious affiliation (%)
indicators.description: Share of the region's enumerated resident population reporting any of the 25 religious-affiliation categories in the 2021 frame.
indicators.method: 100 times the summed constituency religious_affiliation_count divided by the summed constituency population_total.
indicators.quality_notes: Religion is published and staged for 51 electoral constituencies, but no licensed constituency boundary layer exists. The map renders the census's four statistical regions, the workbook's own roll-up, until the Samoa Bureau of Statistics supplies a constituency vector; the full constituency table ships in the committed data product.

indicators.label: No religion (%)

indicators.method: 100 times the summed constituency NO RELIGION count divided by the summed constituency population_total.
